description: Fetches the official Government of India holiday list from cgca.gov.in for administrative offices in Delhi/New Delhi, including both Gazetted and Restricted holidays.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_holidays: Retrieves the holiday list; use holiday_type to filter.; 参数: holiday_type; 必填: 无

holiday_type.description:
Type of holidays to retrieve (used by get_holidays).
Options: "gazetted", "restricted", or "all" (default: "all").
